projects.description: Apartment Management Suite | Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform Product Owner Led product ownership and end-to-end digital transformation for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, architecting scalable solutions for apartment management operations. Designed business processes, data models, and governance frameworks emphasizing data integrity and automated workflows. Managed full project lifecycle as Product Owner, from requirements gathering and architecture to development, testing, and deployment using Agile practices. Oversaw technical architecture and delivery of cloud-based responsive applications. Utilized Generative AI tools to enhance program delivery efficiency in analysis, design, and validation phases. Financial Reporting Automation & Process Transformation Led automation initiatives for financial reporting processes, integrating data governance best practices to ensure accuracy and compliance. Designed a reusable reporting engine to dynamically process supplier data and generate standardized financial reports. Developed batch-processing automation to generate, consolidate, and validate monthly financial reports with minimal manual intervention. Built dynamic data extraction and transformation logic to automate report generation across varying workbook structures. Improved reporting efficiency and data quality by replacing repetitive spreadsheet processes with scalable automation.
